title: bromus villosus subsp. rigidus
intro: Bromus villosus subsp. rigidus, commonly known as rigid brome or hairy brome, is a type of grass that belongs to the family Poaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Bromus villosus subsp. rigidus include its use in traditional medicine to treat various ailments, such as digestive issues and respiratory problems, due to its bioactive constituents. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
